questions.topic: A subject line that could carry two answers

stimulus.body: A short reference note on a subject line that could carry two answers is set for a close-reading task. It states: An ambiguous subject should be split so each request is clear. A marginal reminder adds: split the subject. Four statements are then offered, and only one of them follows from what the note actually says.

questions.stem: The question turns on what the note above shows about a subject line that could carry two answers. Given the proposal "Add more recipients", which choice is consistent with the evidence in the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: an ambiguous subject should be split so each request is clear. On that basis "Split into two clear subjects" is the supported choice. Option B ("Keep it ambiguous") fails because it accepts confusion; Option C ("Remove the subject") fails because it removes routing cue; Option D ("Add more recipients") fails because it dilutes accountability.
